description: Given a product or brand name (or a vehicle make, model and year), returns matching official U.S. recalls from CPSC (consumer products), NHTSA (vehicles) or FDA enforcement reports (food, drugs, medical devices), newest first, normalized to one shape: date, title or product, hazard or reason, remedy, classification, firm and a link to the record. An empty result is an answer. Not charged if a source is down. Costs $0.005 USDC per successful call (x402, eip155:8453); failures are not charged.

category.description: consumer, vehicle, food, drug or device

query.description: Product or brand text, 2-100 chars (not for vehicle)

name: recalls
title: U.S. product recall search
